title: 9th Annual Holiday Market
seo_title: 9th Annual Holiday Market at Joplin Empire Market
description: The 9th Annual Holiday Market is a Saturday market where shoppers can find baked goods, prepared food, produce, local coffee and wine, pastured meat, and artisan vendors. Saint Nick visits during the market, and gift-wrapping is available on select Saturdays. It runs every Saturday from November 21 to December 19, 2026, from 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, at Joplin Empire Market, 998 E 3rd St in Joplin, MO.
address: 998 E 3rd St, Joplin, MO 64801, United States, Joplin, MO
